mapper.select: SELECT id FROM l_admin WHERE account = #{account}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO l_admin ( group_id, account, name, password, salt, description, status, add_time ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{account}, #{name}, #{password}, #{salt}, #{description}, #{status}, #{addTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE l_admin
group_id = #{groupId},
name = #{name},
password = #{password},
salt = #{salt},
description = #{description},
status = #{status},
edit_time = #{editTime}
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT la.*, lagroup.name groupName, (SELECT login_time FROM l_admin_login_record WHERE admin_id = la.id ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT 1) lastLoginTime FROM l_admin la LEFT JOIN l_admin_group lagroup ON la.group_id = lagroup.id WHERE la.id = #{id}
